pages.summary: Katie y Diane bloquean el pasillo. Hermione se pone seria cuando Diane sujeta a Pansy.

panels.scene: Wide shot outside the oak door. Pansy and Hermione beside their sand stroller in left foreground, both fully dressed. Katie and Diane block the aisle from the right, their one wicker bassinet behind them.
panels.caption: Las dos Hufflepuff les cerraban el paso.

panels.scene: Close on Robin and Phoenix looking at each other from their two distinct strollers, small matching scowls as comedy. Navy Robin with green eyes and brown curls, pale yellow Phoenix with light hair and amber eyes.
panels.caption: Hasta los pequeños parecían haber tomado partido.

panels.scene: Hermione looks politely unimpressed at the two rivals. Pansy beside her looks surprised and pleased. Both faces clear, robes and sapphire stable.
dialogue: Hermione: Si esperaban otra lección, hoy no damos clases.

panels.scene: Diane, long light blonde waves, gray eyes and yellow-black uniform, attempts a practiced placating smile. Katie's chestnut high bun visible behind her.
dialogue: Diane: Empezamos con el pie izquierdo.

panels.scene: Pansy takes the stroller handle and prepares to walk past. Hermione stays at her side. Two distinct children safely in separate strollers, no invented crowd.
dialogue: Pansy: Muevan su canasta. Nos estorban.

panels.scene: Diane reaches out and briefly grasps Pansy by the upper uniform sleeve. Pansy looks down, pulls her own arm back and steps away. Clear natural hands and cuffs. No striking, only resistance.
panels.caption: Diane la detuvo por el brazo.

panels.scene: Tense shoulder-up reverse angle. Hermione steps up beside Pansy and meets Diane's eyes firmly. Katie moves beside Diane. Everyone uninjured.

pages.summary: La discusión escala. Hermione lanza el primer hechizo y protege el cochecito de Robin.

panels.scene: Katie high chestnut bun raises two open hands in a false conciliatory gesture, Diane beside her. Same cool stone corridor and door.
dialogue: Katie: Dejen esta competencia. Podemos llevar la fiesta en paz.

panels.scene: Pansy smiles wryly, head angled, green eyes, slim black bob. Hermione stands behind her, hands relaxed.
dialogue: Pansy: Nosotras no competimos. Nosotras sobresalimos.

panels.scene: Katie's placating smile falls. She points one finger at both girls, feet firmly on flagstone. Diane glances approvingly.
dialogue: Katie: Esa pareja perfecta es una farsa para los periódicos.

panels.scene: Close on Hermione's angry brown eyes and one hand reaching for her slender wand under her robe. Diane draws her own wand across from her. Space between them.
panels.caption: Hermione desenfundó la varita.

panels.scene: Wide side view, Hermione's small vivid lilac streak strikes a clean circular blue shield in front of Diane. Diane stays upright and slides one step back. Magic affects only shield, not people. Both strollers behind their families.
Hermione turns her wand gently toward Robin’s sand stroller and surrounds the whole stroller with a clear GOLD protective sphere, Robin safe and calm inside. All rays point away.

Pansy draws the protected stroller a short distance behind the pair with her wand and positions herself next to Hermione. Across corridor Katie stands between her bassinet and the others. Focus on four separate silhouettes.
panels.caption: Pansy puso a Robin a resguardo y tomó su posición.

pages.transcript:

pages.review: Siete viñetas. Se lee el reto y el inicio del duelo. Los dos escudos corresponden a Diane y al cochecito de Robin, respectivamente.

pages.summary: Diane congela el suelo. Hermione responde con viento mientras Pansy intercepta a Katie.

panels.scene: Diane flicks her wand downward. A thin clear blue glaze spreads ONLY across empty flagstones in front of Hermione and Pansy. Their protected stroller remains well behind.
Hermione crouches safely on one knee, turns her wand down the open aisle. Wind ribbons billow robes and blow out two torches; a spell streak passes overhead. No one struck.
Katie stands firmly between wind and her own wicker bassinet, with an amber shield over Phoenix. Diane steps sideways, hair flying. Both infants safe at opposite ends.
panels.caption: Katie protegió la canasta de Phoenix.

panels.scene: Hermione rises, clear floor behind her after melting ice, determined expression and chestnut curls. Pansy visible behind her in green uniform. Hermione points her wand at Katie’s shield from a distance.
dialogue: Hermione: ¡No conocen a Pansy! Ella es auténtica.

panels.scene: Diane's purple Expulso streak is deflected into a stone pier. A few large stone fragments fall into a clear space on floor away from people. Dim hall with torch smoke. No injury or body impact.
From behind Katie, she raises wand toward Hermione’s back while Hermione faces Diane. Pansy notices from the other side. Four distinct readable silhouettes.
panels.caption: Pansy vio el ataque antes que Hermione.

panels.scene: Pansy sweeps wand in a short amber arc toward Katie. Katie’s boots lift a few inches as her ankle levitates, full black trousers and uniform. Pansy’s green eyes, stance and hands clear.

pages.summary: Los hechizos llenan el corredor. El león de Hermione atrae a los primeros testigos.

panels.scene: Katie suspended head down by one boot, safely covered by opaque long black trousers and long yellow-trim uniform jacket. Comical surprised face, chestnut high bun, wand pointed away from stroller.
panels.caption: Katie quedó suspendida por el tobillo.

panels.scene: Hermione deflects a small gray puff with an air shield and casts a flock of luminous magical birds across the empty aisle toward Diane’s shield. Birds never bite or touch a person. Same light and stone.
From Katie’s wand a blue jet splashes across Pansy’s green sleeve and spills into a puddle. Pansy steps back and braces a hand on stone. No violence injuries. Keep wet black bob from here onward.

Pansy kneels on damp stone, makes a wand movement with right hand, visibly wet black chin bob and clothes. Loops of golden magic restrain levitating Katie's wand arm without injury. Hermione across aisle.
Diane points a wand at Hermione, a thin green streak parried safely upward. Hermione turns her wrist, bright gold magic building at her wand.

Heroic wide view. A huge translucent gold lion of light bursts from Hermione’s wand and stops at Diane’s clear shield, both luminous. Nobody is bitten or harmed. Both babies still safe behind their separate clear shields.
panels.caption: Un león de luz iluminó el corredor.

panels.scene: Several Ravenclaw students in blue-bronze uniforms stop in the distance at the corner, watching from well away. Wet Pansy and Hermione face the rivals. Katie still floating near far wall. Clear damaged stone pier in the background.
panels.caption: El estruendo atrajo a los primeros testigos.

pages.summary: Diane libera a Katie. Pansy aparta a Hermione de un hechizo y llena el corredor de humo.

panels.scene: Diane, on one knee, casts upwards. Golden restraining loops break around Katie, who is lowered gently from the ankle spell. Katie wears long black trousers, no injury. Ravenclaws watch far away.
Diane rises and sends a narrow violet streak toward open air near Hermione’s back. Pansy in wet green uniform sees it and reaches toward Hermione’s shoulder.
panels.caption: Pansy vio el destello.

panels.scene: Side view, Pansy moves Hermione sideways with both hands on her shoulders, out of the light streak's path. The magical ribbon curls around Pansy’s black boot. No painful contact.
Pansy levitates briefly from the right boot, fully covered in black trousers and long green-trimmed jacket. Her wand hand makes a small counterspell arc. Comedic surprise, no injury.
Pansy on one knee after landing safely, wet black bob and green uniform, extends wand into the empty aisle. A dense dark-blue magical smoke cloud starts at her wand tip and spreads across stones.
Smoky wide frame, Hermione low on one knee behind clear shield, both strollers protected far back. Two dim wand sparks in distance. The rest of the group mostly silhouettes.
panels.caption: El humo se tragó el pasillo.
